findings.detail: This @import of Google Fonts CSS (Inter, JetBrains Mono) blocks rendering: the browser finds it only after the stylesheet that imports it has downloaded, then waits for another origin. Fix: replace it with a <link rel="stylesheet"> in the HTML head after a preconnect to https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://fonts.gstatic.com, or self-host the fonts.

"JetBrains Mono" declares weight 800 here (Google Fonts URL), but nothing in the scanned files sets font-weight 800 where this family could apply. Fix: remove this weight, unless something the scan cannot see applies it (styles set by scripts, CMS content).

Web fonts load from 2 origins: fonts.googleapis.com (first at src/input.css:2), api.fontshare.com (first at src/input.css:3). Each extra origin needs its own connection before its fonts can download, and fonts split across hosts are harder to preload, cache and audit. Fix: serve all web fonts from one origin, ideally your own.
